## Execution contract

Execute the milestone as seven bounded, starter-only, independently revertible slices. Each implementation slice requires its own review and Founder merge gate. No slice may perform a real child sync.

### Slice 1 — Rebaseline and architecture contract

- Reverify the exact live `main` SHA before planning.
- Record current public exports, CLI arguments, outputs, exit codes, diagnostics, responsibility map, dependency graph, test ownership, file metrics, and representative context cost.
- Add `scripts/AGENTS.md`, `scripts/ARCHITECTURE.md`, and a machine-readable dependency contract integrated into the normal guard/check path.
- Preserve every current public root entrypoint.

### Slice 2 — Harness-contract guard facade

- Extract child-script policy, runtime import parsing, managed runtime closure, and diagnostics.
- Preserve `scripts/guard-harness-contract.mjs` as the stable facade.

### Slice 3 — Mission Control contract guard facade

- Extract canonical inventory, guide/module rules, transport rules, managed-path rules, and diagnostics.
- Preserve rule IDs, evaluation ordering, messages, exports, and exit behavior.

### Slice 4 — Boilerplate-sync composition root

- Extract inventory/configuration, package contract proposal, filesystem projection, Git/stash lifecycle, command gates, and reporting.
- Preserve sync ownership, merge/keep behavior, child portability, CLI behavior, and public exports.

### Slice 5 — Mission Control reconciliation facade

- Extract pure reconciliation state logic, comment identity/recovery, Founder protocols, child-sync gates, Issue-body CAS/lease adapters, and CLI composition.
- Preserve idempotency, single-winner semantics, review counters, fail-closed classifications, and every existing authority contract.

### Slice 6 — Dependency-cycle retirement

- Remove the existing nine-node / sixteen-edge strongly connected component.
- Remove the transitional cycle allowlist.
- Require no strongly connected dependency component larger than one module.
- Keep the architecture rule enforced through the normal guard/check path.

### Slice 7 — Test ownership split and architecture closeout

- Split the oversized boilerplate-sync integration suite by responsibility without losing or weakening assertions.
- Make agent-delivery consume approved shared adapters only when the change is mechanical, bounded, and independently justified; otherwise record it as a non-blocking follow-up.
- Produce final before/after metrics and simulated child-delivery evidence.
